items.title: Neon Cityscape at Midnight
items.description: Create a cyberpunk-inspired city scene with glowing neon signs reflected in rain-slicked streets. Focus on color contrast between warm neons and cool shadows.

items.title: Golden Hour Self-Portrait
items.description: Paint a self-portrait during golden hour lighting. Capture the warm orange and pink tones on skin and the soft shadows they create.

items.title: 100 Hands Challenge
items.description: Draw 100 different hand poses and gestures. Focus on different ages, expressions, and actions. Great anatomy practice.

items.title: Reflections in Puddles
items.description: Capture the world reflected in puddles after rain. Shoot from ground level to create surreal upside-down cityscapes or nature scenes.

items.title: Magazine Collage Portrait
items.description: Create a portrait using only cut-outs from magazines. Layer textures, patterns, and colors to build facial features and emotions.

items.title: Mythical Creature Mashup
items.description: Combine elements from two different mythological creatures (like a griffin and kitsune) to create an original being with its own backstory.

items.title: Floating Island Ecosystem
items.description: Design a floating island with its own unique ecosystem. Consider how plants and animals adapted to aerial life and limited resources.

items.title: App Icon Series
items.description: Design a cohesive set of 10 app icons with a consistent style. Try flat design, skeuomorphism, or glassmorphism.

items.title: Underwater Temple Ruins
items.description: Illustrate ancient temple ruins submerged underwater. Play with light rays filtering through water and bioluminescent sea life.

items.title: Emotions in Abstract
items.description: Express a specific emotion (joy, grief, anxiety, peace) using only abstract shapes, colors, and brushstrokes. No representational imagery.

items.title: Urban Sketching - Your Neighborhood
items.description: Sketch a scene from your neighborhood in 30 minutes. Capture the essence with quick, confident lines. Include at least one person.

items.title: Light Painting Portraits
items.description: Create long-exposure portraits using light painting. Use flashlights, LED strips, or sparklers to paint around your subject.

items.title: Nature Journal Page
items.description: Create a nature journal spread combining pressed flowers, sketches, watercolor, and handwritten observations about local flora.

items.title: Villain Turned Hero
items.description: Redesign a classic villain as a hero. Change their color palette, posture, and accessories while keeping them recognizable.

items.title: Post-Apocalyptic Mall
items.description: Design an abandoned shopping mall 50 years after an apocalypse. Show how nature reclaimed the space and how survivors repurposed it.

items.title: Retro Poster - Modern Product
items.description: Design an advertisement for a modern product (smartphone, streaming service) in the style of 1950s vintage posters.

items.title: Cozy Reading Nook
items.description: Illustrate your ideal reading spot. Focus on warm lighting, comfortable textures, and small personal details that make a space feel lived-in.

items.title: Storm Clouds Study
items.description: Paint dramatic storm clouds in oils or acrylics. Study how light breaks through and how colors shift from bright sky to dark clouds.

items.title: Texture Study Sheet
items.description: Fill a page with small squares, each showing a different texture: fur, scales, bark, metal, fabric, water, etc. Practice rendering techniques.

items.title: One Color Challenge
items.description: Photograph a series where one specific color (red, blue, yellow) is the dominant element in every image. Find it in unexpected places.

items.title: Map of a Fictional Place
items.description: Create a detailed map of an imaginary location using coffee staining, pen work, and collage. Add legends, compass roses, and sea monsters.

items.title: Everyday Hero
items.description: Design a superhero based on an everyday profession: teacher, nurse, librarian, chef. Their powers relate to their job skills.

items.title: Bioluminescent Forest
items.description: Create a forest ecosystem where all life is bioluminescent. Design the plants, fungi, and creatures that would thrive in permanent darkness.

items.title: Album Cover Art
items.description: Design an album cover for a fictional band. Create the band name, album title, and artwork that reflects a specific music genre.

items.title: Witch's Kitchen
items.description: Illustrate a witch's cozy kitchen filled with bubbling potions, hanging herbs, spell books, and magical ingredients. Add a familiar pet.

items.title: Portrait of a Pet
items.description: Paint a portrait of a pet (yours or a friend's) showing their unique personality. Capture their eyes and expression with care.

items.title: Blind Contour Faces
items.description: Draw 10 portraits without looking at your paper (blind contour technique). Focus on training hand-eye coordination.

items.title: Shadows as Subjects
items.description: Create a photo series where shadows are the main subject. Capture interesting shadow patterns from everyday objects.

items.title: Altered Book Art
items.description: Transform an old book into art. Cut, fold, paint, and collage pages to create a sculptural or visual piece.

items.title: Seasonal Spirits
items.description: Design four spirits representing each season. Show how their appearance, colors, and accessories reflect their season's traits.

items.title: Underground City
items.description: Design a city built entirely underground. Consider lighting solutions, architecture, transportation, and how residents get food and air.

items.title: Personal Logo
items.description: Create a personal logo/monogram using your initials. Try at least 10 different approaches before choosing a favorite.

items.title: Space Station Garden
items.description: Illustrate a garden aboard a space station. Combine the sterile tech of space travel with lush growing plants and soft natural light.

items.title: Still Life with Meaning
items.description: Arrange and paint a still life where every object has personal significance to you. Create a visual autobiography.

items.title: Architecture Sketch Walk
items.description: Walk around your area and sketch 5 different architectural details: doorways, windows, rooflines, or decorative elements.

items.title: Morning Routine Documentary
items.description: Document your entire morning routine in photos. Capture the mundane beauty of everyday rituals.

items.title: Memory Box Art
items.description: Create a small shadow box containing objects and imagery representing a significant memory. Layer 2D and 3D elements.

items.title: Age Progression
items.description: Design the same character at ages 5, 15, 35, and 70. Show how their personality and life experiences change their appearance.

items.title: Living Architecture
items.description: Design buildings grown from living plants and trees. Show how different building types (home, office, temple) would look.

items.title: Tarot Card Design
items.description: Create your own interpretation of a major arcana tarot card. Research traditional symbolism, then add your personal twist.

items.title: Rainy Window View
items.description: Paint the view through a rain-streaked window. Focus on how water droplets distort and blur the world outside.

items.title: Monochromatic Landscape
items.description: Paint a landscape using only shades of one color (blue, sepia, green). Learn how value creates depth without hue variety.

items.title: Gesture Drawings - 60 Seconds
items.description: Do 20 one-minute gesture drawings of people. Focus on capturing motion and weight, not details.

items.title: Macro World
items.description: Explore macro photography. Find tiny subjects (insects, flowers, textures) and reveal details invisible to the naked eye.

items.title: Fabric Collage Landscape
items.description: Create a landscape using only fabric scraps. Layer textures for sky, mountains, trees, and water.

items.title: Emotion Expressions Sheet
items.description: Create an expression sheet for your character showing 20 different emotions. Push the expressions to extremes.

items.title: Desert Oasis Civilization
items.description: Design a civilization built around a desert oasis. Show architecture, clothing, and customs adapted to the harsh environment.

items.title: Food Packaging Redesign
items.description: Redesign the packaging for a common grocery item. Make it more appealing, sustainable, or fun.

items.title: Potion Ingredient Study
items.description: Illustrate a collection of magical potion ingredients: glowing mushrooms, dragon scales, moonflowers, etc. with labels.

items.title: Reflections in Metal
items.description: Paint a chrome or metallic object showing complex reflections of its environment. Study how metal distorts what it reflects.

items.title: Favorite Book Scene
items.description: Illustrate a scene from your favorite book that has never been officially illustrated. Interpret the author's words visually.

items.title: Local Wildlife Watch
items.description: Photograph local wildlife in your area. Birds, squirrels, insects - document the creatures sharing your space.

items.title: Ephemera Postcard
items.description: Create a postcard using ephemera (tickets, stamps, receipts, wrappers) from a memorable day or trip.

items.title: Animal Anthro Warrior
items.description: Design an anthropomorphic animal warrior. Consider how their animal traits influence their fighting style and armor design.

items.title: Steampunk Transportation
items.description: Design vehicles for a steampunk world: personal transport, public transit, and cargo hauling. Mix Victorian aesthetics with impossible machinery.

items.title: Enamel Pin Designs
items.description: Design 5 enamel pins in a cohesive theme (plants, space, food, animals). Keep designs simple and bold for manufacturing.

items.title: Afrofuturist Portrait
items.description: Create a portrait that blends African cultural elements with futuristic technology. Celebrate heritage through a sci-fi lens.

items.title: Impasto Texture Exploration
items.description: Create a painting using heavy impasto technique. Let brushstrokes and palette knife marks become part of the artwork.

items.title: Daily Doodle Challenge
items.description: Draw one small doodle every day for a month. Keep them simple (5 minutes max) but try to vary subjects.

items.title: Golden Hour Portraits
items.description: Photograph portraits during golden hour. Master the warm, soft light of sunrise or sunset.

items.title: Woven Paper Art
items.description: Create art by weaving strips of different papers together. Use patterns, photos, or painted papers.

items.title: Modern Deity
items.description: Design a deity for the modern age - god of WiFi, goddess of caffeine, spirit of social media. Give them appropriate divine attributes.

items.title: Giant Creature Village
items.description: Design a village built on or around a giant sleeping creature. How do residents live with their unusual foundation?

items.title: Event Poster
items.description: Design a poster for a local or fictional event. Include all necessary information while creating visual impact.

items.title: Seasonal Tree
items.description: Illustrate the same tree in all four seasons. Show how light, color, and environment change throughout the year.

items.title: Colorful Hair Portrait
items.description: Paint a portrait featuring vibrant, unnatural hair colors. Practice rendering reflective, colorful strands.

items.title: Mechanical Breakdown
items.description: Draw an exploded view of a mechanical object showing all its parts separated but in spatial relationship.

items.title: Architecture Abstract
items.description: Photograph architectural details abstractly - focus on patterns, lines, and shapes rather than recognizable buildings.

items.title: Music Visualization
items.description: Listen to a song and create art that represents how it makes you feel. Use any media that fits the mood.

items.title: Nightmare Creature
items.description: Design a creature from nightmares. Research sleep paralysis demons and childhood fears for inspiration.

items.title: Gravity-Shifted City
items.description: Design a city where gravity works differently - maybe it pulls toward the center, or changes direction by district.

items.title: Book Cover Series
items.description: Design covers for a three-book series. Create visual continuity while giving each book its own identity.

items.title: Glitch Art Portrait
items.description: Create a portrait incorporating intentional digital glitches. Experiment with data bending, pixel sorting, and corruption effects.

items.title: Alla Prima Portrait
items.description: Complete a portrait in a single painting session (alla prima/wet-on-wet). Work quickly and embrace imperfections.

items.title: Comic Strip
items.description: Create a 4-panel comic strip about something that happened to you today. Practice visual storytelling.

items.title: Food Styling
items.description: Style and photograph a meal like it's for a cookbook. Pay attention to props, lighting, and composition.

items.title: Found Poetry Visual
items.description: Create found poetry from old books or newspapers, then create visual art around the words you selected.

items.title: D&D Character Portrait
items.description: Design a Dungeons & Dragons character with full backstory. Show their class, race, equipment, and personality.

items.title: Crystal Cave Ecosystem
items.description: Design life forms that evolved in giant crystal caves. How do they navigate, communicate, and survive?

items.title: Infographic Design
items.description: Design an infographic explaining something you know well. Make complex information visual and accessible.

items.title: Pixel Art Room
items.description: Create a detailed pixel art scene of an interior room. Limit yourself to a small color palette.

items.title: Nocturne Study
items.description: Paint a night scene focusing on how artificial and natural light sources interact in darkness.

items.title: Extreme Perspective
items.description: Draw a scene with dramatic perspective - extreme worm's eye or bird's eye view. Push the vanishing points.

items.title: Forced Perspective
items.description: Create photos using forced perspective illusions - make small things look giant or vice versa.

items.title: Zine Creation
items.description: Create a mini zine (8-page fold from one sheet). Pick a theme and fill it with drawings, collage, or photos.

items.title: Historical Figure Reimagined
items.description: Redesign a historical figure as a fantasy or sci-fi character. Keep their personality traits while changing the setting.

items.title: Nomadic Sky People
items.description: Design a culture that lives entirely in airships or on flying creatures. Show their homes, customs, and technology.

items.title: Brand Identity Kit
items.description: Create a complete brand identity for a fictional business: logo, colors, typography, and application examples.

items.title: Mermaid Redesign
items.description: Redesign mermaids based on real deep-sea fish. Create beautiful but unsettling creatures of the deep.

items.title: Color Temperature Study
items.description: Paint a scene focusing only on warm vs cool colors. Practice using temperature to create depth and mood.

items.title: Object Drawing: 50 Items
items.description: Draw 50 different everyday objects from observation. Focus on accuracy and rendering techniques.

items.title: Street Photography Day
items.description: Spend a day doing street photography. Capture candid moments, interesting characters, and urban life.

items.title: Embroidered Photo
items.description: Print a photo and add embroidery over it. Use thread to highlight, decorate, or transform the image.

items.title: Weather Personification
items.description: Design characters representing different weather phenomena: thunder, fog, sunshine, hurricane. Show their personalities.

items.title: Mushroom Kingdom
items.description: Design a civilization of small creatures living in a giant mushroom forest. Scale everyday things to their perspective.

items.title: Playing Card Design
items.description: Design a complete suit of playing cards (13 cards) with a unique theme. Create consistent court card illustrations.

items.title: Isometric Room
items.description: Create an isometric illustration of a themed room (game room, music studio, garden shed). Pack in details.

items.title: Plein Air Challenge
items.description: Take your paints outside and paint from life. Complete a landscape or urban scene in natural light.

items.title: Continuous Line Portrait
items.description: Draw a portrait without lifting your pen from the paper. Create a flowing, connected line drawing.

items.title: Self-Portrait Project
items.description: Create a series of self-portraits that tell a story or explore your identity. Use creative lighting and composition.

items.title: Air-Dry Clay Figure
items.description: Create a small figure or creature from air-dry clay. Focus on form and gesture over fine details.

items.title: VHS Aesthetic Illustration
items.description: Create art in the style of 80s VHS covers. Include scan lines, vintage colors, and retro typography.

items.title: Complementary Color Scene
items.description: Paint a scene using primarily complementary colors (red/green, blue/orange, purple/yellow). Master color vibration.

items.title: Interior Sketch
items.description: Sketch the room you're in right now. Focus on capturing space, furniture, and light.

items.title: Double Exposure
items.description: Create double exposure images, either in-camera or in post. Blend portraits with textures or landscapes.

items.title: Mail Art Exchange
items.description: Create a piece of mail art to send to a friend. Decorate an envelope or postcard with mixed media.

items.title: Robot Companion
items.description: Design a friendly robot companion for daily life. Consider its personality, function, and visual design language.

items.title: Clockwork City
items.description: Design a city that runs entirely on clockwork mechanisms. Show the gears, springs, and mechanical systems.

items.title: Social Media Template
items.description: Design a set of social media post templates for a specific brand or purpose. Include multiple layouts.

items.title: Magic Item Collection
items.description: Illustrate a collection of magical items for an RPG: weapons, armor, potions, and artifacts.

items.title: Fog and Mist Study
items.description: Paint a scene heavy with fog or mist. Practice how atmosphere affects value and color.

items.title: Vehicle Design
items.description: Design a vehicle that doesn't exist yet - flying car, hover bike, submarine bus. Make it functional-looking.

items.title: Blue Hour Magic
items.description: Photograph during blue hour (just after sunset). Capture the beautiful blue tones and city lights.

items.title: Gratitude Art Journal
items.description: Create a journal page about something you're grateful for. Combine writing, drawing, and collage.

items.title: Zodiac Character
items.description: Design a character based on your zodiac sign. Incorporate the sign's symbols, colors, and personality traits.

items.title: Vertical City
items.description: Design a city that exists entirely vertically - on a cliff face, in a chasm, or on a giant tree trunk.

items.title: Sticker Sheet
items.description: Design a sheet of stickers around a theme. Keep designs simple, cute, and die-cut friendly.

items.title: Dream Sequence
items.description: Illustrate a scene from a dream you've had. Embrace surreal logic and impossible scenarios.

items.title: Underwater Portrait
items.description: Paint a portrait as if the subject is underwater. Show floating hair, distorted light, and bubbles.

items.title: Childhood Toy Portrait
items.description: Draw a detailed portrait of a toy from your childhood. Capture the memories and wear.

items.title: Minimal Composition
items.description: Create minimalist photos with lots of negative space. Focus on single subjects and clean compositions.

items.title: Recipe Art
items.description: Turn a favorite recipe into an illustrated artwork. Include ingredients, steps, and personal memories.

items.title: Food Mascot
items.description: Design a mascot character for a food product or restaurant. Make it memorable and brand-appropriate.

items.title: Ice Age Society
items.description: Design a human society that survived an ice age. Show their architecture, clothing, and survival technology.

items.title: T-Shirt Design
items.description: Create a t-shirt design you'd want to wear. Consider printing limitations and visual impact from a distance.

items.title: Synthwave Landscape
items.description: Create a retro-futuristic synthwave landscape with neon grids, chrome mountains, and sunset gradients.

items.title: Water Reflection Study
items.description: Paint a scene with water reflections. Study how reflections differ from what they're reflecting.

items.title: Fantasy Map
items.description: Draw a detailed fantasy map for an imaginary world. Include terrain, cities, and decorative elements.

items.title: Flat Lay Collection
items.description: Create flat lay photos of themed collections: your bag contents, craft supplies, favorite things.

items.title: Pressed Flower Art
items.description: Collect and press flowers, then create artwork incorporating them. Add drawing or painting around them.

items.title: Opposite Day
items.description: Take one of your existing characters and design their opposite. Flip their personality, aesthetic, and role.

items.title: Solarpunk Future
items.description: Design an optimistic future city where technology and nature exist in harmony. Show green architecture.

items.title: Menu Design
items.description: Design a restaurant menu. Consider hierarchy, readability, and how design reflects the restaurant's vibe.

items.title: Magical Library
items.description: Illustrate a magical library with floating books, hidden passages, and mystical lighting.

items.title: Colorful Shadows
items.description: Paint a scene where shadows aren't gray or black but vibrant colors. Study how light affects shadow color.

items.title: Skeleton Study
items.description: Draw a human skeleton from reference. Understand how bones create the framework for the body.

items.title: Motion Blur Art
items.description: Experiment with intentional camera movement to create abstract motion blur images.

items.title: Texture Rubbing Collection
items.description: Create a collection of texture rubbings from interesting surfaces. Arrange them into a composition.

items.title: Elemental Guardians
items.description: Design guardians for each classical element: earth, water, fire, air. Show their elemental powers visually.

items.title: Abandoned Theme Park
items.description: Design an abandoned theme park being reclaimed by nature. Tell stories through the decay.

items.title: Calendar Illustration
items.description: Create illustrations for each month of a calendar. Consider seasonal themes and visual consistency.

items.title: Holographic Portrait
items.description: Create a portrait with holographic/iridescent effects. Play with rainbow colors and light refraction.

items.title: Broken Glass Effect
items.description: Paint a portrait or scene as if viewed through broken glass, with fragments showing different perspectives.

items.title: Negative Space Drawing
items.description: Draw the negative space around an object rather than the object itself. Train your eye to see differently.

items.title: Pet Personality
items.description: Create a photo series capturing your pet's personality. Show their quirks, habits, and character.

items.title: Timeline Art
items.description: Create a visual timeline of your life or a year using photos, tickets, drawings, and memorabilia.

items.title: Plant Person
items.description: Design a character that's part plant, part person. Show how photosynthesis and growth affect their life.

items.title: Library Dimension
items.description: Design a dimension that's an infinite library. Show impossible architecture and the guardians who maintain it.

items.title: Icon Set
items.description: Design a cohesive icon set for a specific app or website. Maintain consistent style across all icons.

items.title: Candy Kingdom
items.description: Illustrate a kingdom made entirely of candy and sweets. Design the architecture and inhabitants.

items.title: Fabric Draping Study
items.description: Set up and paint draped fabric. Study how folds create shadows and how different fabrics behave.

items.title: Cross-Section Drawing
items.description: Draw a cross-section of something: a building, a fruit, a machine, an animal. Show what's inside.

items.title: Day in the Life
items.description: Document an entire day in photos, from waking up to going to sleep. Tell your daily story.

items.title: Monotype Print
items.description: Create monotype prints using glass or plexiglass. Experiment with this unique one-of-a-kind printmaking.

items.title: Music Genre Personified
items.description: Design characters representing different music genres: punk, classical, hip-hop, country, electronic.

items.title: Micro Civilization
items.description: Design a civilization of tiny beings living in a human garden. Show their cities, transportation, and culture.

items.title: Wine Label
items.description: Design a wine or beer label. Balance elegance with information and create shelf appeal.

items.title: Ghost Town
items.description: Illustrate an Old West ghost town at twilight. Add subtle supernatural elements hidden throughout.

items.title: Painting from a Song
items.description: Listen to a song and paint what you see in your mind. Let the music guide your colors and composition.

items.title: Upside Down Drawing
items.description: Turn a reference photo upside down and draw it that way. This tricks your brain into seeing shapes, not symbols.

items.title: Symmetry Hunt
items.description: Photograph symmetrical subjects. Seek out natural and architectural symmetry in your environment.

items.title: Vision Board
items.description: Create an artistic vision board for your goals. Make it beautiful, not just functional.

items.title: Familiar Spirits
items.description: Design familiar spirits (magical animal companions) for different types of magic users.

items.title: Underwater City
items.description: Design an underwater city for air-breathing inhabitants. Show how they solved the engineering challenges.

items.title: Letterhead Design
items.description: Design complete business stationery: letterhead, envelope, and business card with cohesive branding.

items.title: Overgrown Technology
items.description: Illustrate modern technology being overtaken by nature - computers with vines, phones with moss.

items.title: Knife Painting Only
items.description: Complete a painting using only palette knives, no brushes. Embrace bold marks and texture.

items.title: Eye Study Collection
items.description: Draw eyes from many different angles, ages, and expressions. Build a reference sheet.

items.title: Through the Window
items.description: Photograph scenes through windows. Capture reflections, frames, and the barrier between inside and out.

items.title: Seed Packet Art
items.description: Design vintage-style seed packets for fantastical plants. Include planting instructions.

items.title: Shapeshifter Forms
items.description: Design a shapeshifter and all their different forms. Keep recognizable elements across transformations.

items.title: Tree City
items.description: Design a city built in and around giant trees. Show how different levels serve different purposes.

items.title: Magazine Spread
items.description: Design a two-page magazine spread for an article of your choice. Balance text and images.

items.title: Cottagecore Scene
items.description: Create a cozy cottagecore illustration: gardens, baking, rustic homes, and pastoral peace.

items.title: Movement in Stillness
items.description: Paint a still image that conveys motion - flowing water, blowing wind, falling leaves.

items.title: Mechanical Creature
items.description: Design a creature that's part organic, part mechanical. Show how the systems integrate.

items.title: Bokeh Light Art
items.description: Create images with beautiful bokeh. Experiment with different light sources and aperture settings.

items.title: Accordion Book
items.description: Create a small accordion-fold book telling a visual story. Each panel should connect to the next.

items.title: Constellation Being
items.description: Design a being made of stars and constellations. Show how they shift and change with the night sky.

items.title: Floating Market
items.description: Design a market that takes place on boats or floating platforms. Show the goods, vendors, and atmosphere.

items.title: Postage Stamp Set
items.description: Design a series of commemorative stamps around a theme. Work within the small format constraints.

items.title: Magical Girl Transformation
items.description: Design a magical girl character including their transformation sequence and magical form.

items.title: Rim Lighting Portrait
items.description: Paint a portrait with dramatic rim lighting (light from behind the subject). Master the glowing edges.

items.title: Drapery Challenge
items.description: Draw fabric in 10 different situations: hanging, draped, twisted, wet, flowing, etc.

items.title: Texture Exploration
items.description: Create a photo series focused entirely on textures. Get close and fill the frame with surface detail.

items.title: Painted Photo
items.description: Print a photo and paint over it, extending the scene beyond the photo's edges or adding elements.

items.title: Outfit Variations
items.description: Design 7 different outfits for one character, one for each day of the week. Show their style range.

items.title: Coral City
items.description: Design a city built from and integrated with living coral. Show the symbiotic relationship.

items.title: App Loading Screens
items.description: Design interesting loading screens for an app. Make waiting entertaining.

items.title: Bioluminescent Sea
items.description: Illustrate a night ocean scene lit only by bioluminescent creatures. Focus on the glow effects.

items.title: Single Light Source
items.description: Paint a scene lit by a single light source (candle, lamp, screen). Master dramatic lighting.

items.title: Hands Holding Things
items.description: Draw hands holding 10 different objects. Focus on how hands grip different shapes and weights.

items.title: Silhouette Stories
items.description: Create silhouette photographs that tell stories through shape and body language alone.

items.title: Newspaper Collage
items.description: Create art using newspaper and magazine clippings. Layer text and images to create meaning.

items.title: Evolution Design
items.description: Design a creature and show its evolution across 5 stages from primitive to advanced form.

items.title: Mirror World
items.description: Design a world that's a mirror/opposite of ours. What would familiar places look like reversed?

items.title: Chocolate Bar Packaging
items.description: Design luxurious chocolate bar packaging. Create an unboxing experience through design.

items.title: Spirit Animal Guide
items.description: Illustrate your spirit animal in a mystical setting. Add ethereal, spiritual elements.

items.title: Expressive Brushwork
items.description: Paint a scene focusing on visible, expressive brushwork. Let each stroke show emotion.

items.title: Favorite Memory
items.description: Draw your favorite memory. Focus on capturing the feeling more than perfect accuracy.

items.title: Embroidered Affirmation
items.description: Embroider a positive affirmation or quote. Practice lettering with thread.

items.title: Avatar Creator
items.description: Design multiple avatar options (hair, features, accessories) that work together as a system.

items.title: Loose Watercolor Florals
items.description: Paint flowers in loose watercolor style. Let the paint flow and embrace happy accidents.

items.title: Tree Species Study
items.description: Draw 10 different tree species. Study how bark, branches, and leaves differ.

items.title: Lens Flare Magic
items.description: Intentionally capture beautiful lens flare. Learn to work with this often-avoided effect.

items.title: Book Cover Alteration
items.description: Alter an old book cover with paint, collage, and embellishments. Transform its identity.

items.title: Cafe Worker Characters
items.description: Design the cast of characters who work at a cozy fantasy cafe. Give each a unique personality.

items.title: Storm Chasers Culture
items.description: Design a culture that follows and lives with massive storms. Show their technology and traditions.

items.title: Tattoo Flash Sheet
items.description: Create a flash sheet of small tattoo designs around a theme. Design for skin placement.

items.title: Cyberpunk Street Food
items.description: Illustrate a street food vendor in a cyberpunk city. Show the clash of low-tech food and high-tech setting.

items.title: Wet Street Reflections
items.description: Paint a city street after rain. Focus on reflections in puddles and wet surfaces.

items.title: Foot Study
items.description: Draw feet from 20 different angles. Often neglected but essential anatomy to master.

items.title: Candid Emotions
items.description: Capture genuine emotional moments in candid photography. No posed shots allowed.

items.title: Matchbox Art
items.description: Create tiny dioramas inside matchboxes. Tell a story in a miniature space.

items.title: Mech Pilot
items.description: Design a mech pilot and their machine. Show the relationship between operator and robot.

items.title: Spice Trade Route
items.description: Design locations along a fantasy spice trade route. Show different cultures connected by trade.

items.title: Board Game Box
items.description: Design the box art and logo for a board game. Create intrigue and convey the game's theme.

items.title: Enchanted Greenhouse
items.description: Illustrate a magical greenhouse with plants that glow, move, or have unusual properties.

items.title: Thick vs Thin Paint
items.description: Create a painting exploring the contrast between thick impasto and thin glazes.

items.title: Facial Hair Styles
items.description: Draw the same face with 12 different facial hair styles. Study how it changes perception.

items.title: Leading Lines
items.description: Create photos that use leading lines to draw the viewer's eye through the image.

items.title: Treasure Map
items.description: Create an aged treasure map with tea-staining, burned edges, and mysterious symbols.

items.title: Shadow Self
